title: Evaluation of the next parity node inputs
statement: Let $n,r,q$ be natural numbers, let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, let $g$ index one of $r^q$ groups, and let $a$ assign a sign to each of the $r$ positions in a block. The OR gate applied to the bottom-layer values at level $q+1$ over the specified input set equals the exact OR-node value: it is $1$ if $a$ equals the height-$1$ parity-tree assignment for group $g$, and $-1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
$a$ is a sign assignment on $	ext{Fin}(r)$
